bio.text: Rod Pelton (Rodney Pelton) is a Republican who represents District 35 in the Colorado State Senate, where he took office on January 9, 2023, according to Ballotpedia, which lists him as on the November 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his prior office as the Colorado House of Representatives, District 65, from 2019 to 2023.
It says his career experience includes owning and operating businesses and working as a farmer and rancher, and that he served on the Cheyenne County Commission.
